Date Sept. 23, 1931.
23 - 9 - 31

Subject (in full) Movements of A.P. Serebroff, Soviet Citizen.

Made by D.S. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [Signature]

The undermentioned Soviet citizen left Shanghai for
Dairen on September 22,1931 by the s.s. Choshun Maru.
A.P. Serebroff Reported to be chief representative of
the Far Eastern Lumber Trust in China
and Japan.
While in Shanghai he resided at 26
Hwakee Avenue,1025 Bubbling Well Road.

G. Prokofer.
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Mr Yas,

"The usual authorities."

movements of one A.P. Serebroff.

Yours sincerely,
